candidate.title: poll_feed job processes unbounded RSS items, creating/enqueuing work for every entry in a single run
reports: [advisory] pollfeed fetches the feed with open() and then iterates rss.items with no count cap, running postcreator (which enqueues per-post processing jobs) for every item in a single job. a feed with thousands of entries becomes one multi-hour job that floods the sidekiq queue with per-post jobs and mints thousands of topics in one poll — no bound exists anywhere on this path.
